description: Focused Ralph repair loop from Hermes browser dogfood. Fix WebUI/data completeness issues found on 2026-05-17. Follow TDD/BDD, add regression tests, run quality gates, commit one story per iteration.

userStories.name: Fix Northwind E2E seed wipe so seeded ontology is populated and idempotent
userStories.description: Hermes dogfood found /explorer/northwind empty. Running scripts/e2e-setup.sh fails during test/fixtures/e2e_seed.sh with: seed: wipe: delete ontology: ERROR: update or delete on table "ontologies" violates foreign key constraint "functions_ontology_rid_fkey" on table "functions" (SQLSTATE 23503). Investigate seed_northwind wipe order and related FK dependencies; fix root cause so repeated seed runs converge and Northwind has object types/data.
bdd_acceptance: Given an existing dev database that may contain a prior northwind ontology with functions, When ./scripts/e2e-setup.sh runs, Then it completes successfully without foreign-key violations.
Given the setup has completed, When a browser opens /explorer/northwind, Then the OBJECT TYPES list is non-empty and the page does not show "No object types".
Given the setup has completed, When GET /api/v2/ontologies/northwind/objectTypes is called, Then the JSON data array has length greater than 0.
Given the Northwind seed is run twice, When the second run completes, Then it is idempotent and does not leave duplicate or partial ontology state.
dogfood_evidence: scripts/e2e-setup.sh output: functions_ontology_rid_fkey violation on table functions during northwind wipe.

userStories.name: Fix Dashboard total object type metric to reflect actual per-ontology counts
userStories.description: Dashboard shows 0 object types while IoT Demo card shows 4 types. Source currently hardcodes totalObjectTypes = 0 in web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx. Replace with real aggregation over fetched per-ontology object types or a tested API-backed count; handle loading/error states without misleading 0.
bdd_acceptance: Given the dashboard loads ontologies with object type counts, When at least one ontology has object types, Then the global Object Types stat equals the sum of per-card counts rather than 0.
Given IoT Demo has 4 object types and Northwind has seeded types, When / is opened in the browser, Then the dashboard Object Types stat is greater than or equal to 4 and matches API-derived totals.
Given per-ontology object type fetches are still loading, When the dashboard renders, Then it does not present a final misleading 0 as the completed total.
